services.desc: MAXIMALIST MYTHOLOGIES CONTINUE with exotic tales of utopias and demons, hidden treasures, love lessons, illicit pleasures and magic! Pier Paolo Pasolini traveled to Ethiopia, India, Nepal, Yemen and Iran for this cinematic adaptation of erotic stories told by Scherazade in the legendary 1001 Nights “The truth is not revealed in one dream, but in many…” The final and most visually spectacular of Pasolini’s "Trilogy of Life", this ambitious, globetrotting production breathtakingly showcases the landscapes of Ethiopia, Eritrea, Nepal, and Yemen, to spin stories told by Scherazade in 1001 Nights in the spirit of their original telling.
